claim_label: approximate reproduction; frozen crop-group output filtering diagnostic

duplicate_suppression.shared_parent_exception: preserve overlapping groups with different readings when they share an ambiguous parent crop
duplicate_suppression.ranking: frozen input-method score descending; stable group/candidate ID ties

evidence_abstention.rule: retain if a core candidate is an original baseline crop OR at least two distinct core RGB crops have the selected normalized reading

evaluation.metric: one-to-one exact text and axis-aligned bbox IoU; local diagnostic, not official Total-Text Hmean

scientific_choices.choice: Paper section 3.3 specifies contour crops and PARSeq recognition, not group-output suppression or abstention.
Frozen original crop groups, OCR readings, soft probabilities and selected outputs supply all inference inputs.
Generic 0.5 box/soft-mask overlap, greedy duplicate selection, multiword-parent exception and baseline-or-distinct-crop corroboration; no TEST metric or annotation chooses a rule.
Transfer of these fixed postfilters and matching to official polygon spotting evaluation remains unqualified.
